testFixes.reason: GET /api/items/:id returns an ItemView (item nested), so title is read from body.item.

testFixes.test: REQ-005 AC1: A bidder who selects CHF, EUR or USD sees item prices and bids converted with a rate obtained from Frankfurter.
testFixes.reason: Fake item used a non-existent field highestBid; Item attribute is highestBidAmount. Fixed shared helper (also affects REQ-005 AC3, AC4, REQ-010 AC3, SEQ-006).
Topic name 'bid' was guessed and is not in the design; events now come from the real BidEventPublisher (also REQ-007 AC1, AC2).

testFixes.test: REQ-010 AC3: When Frankfurter cannot be reached and no valid cached rate exists, prices are shown only in the item currency and bidding still works.
testFixes.reason: The assertion that displayCurrency is null is not required by the criterion or design; the criterion only requires no converted prices. Removed it, kept the null converted prices checks.
